findings.what: Offer expiry is passed on only by a 5-minute cron sweep; next patient may get the offer up to ~5 min after the 30-min deadline, or never if cron is not running
Freed slot is not held while offered; any online booker can take it before the waitlisted patient accepts, weakening 'take the freed slot'
Nonce rotated before booking; a non-domain error in createAppointment leaves the entry 'offered' with a dead link until the sweep expires it
Patient reschedule frees the old slot but does not offer it to the waitlist
v1 reassignAppointment does not check target doctor leave (new leave-resolution path does)
Staff walk-ins can still book a doctor on leave; deliberate but not specified by the PRD
No edit/delete for leave records and no overlap check between leave ranges
